notes.title: Release Day!
notes.notes:
It's release day, hooray!

We are very proud to release our first game on Steam today and hope you can enjoy some truly uncanny and frightening moments in the world we created.

Tell us what you think about the game, the story and how your playthrough went. 

- The Insanity VR/ Threevol Team
